name: Connections
title: Rouh Link: other people's Rouhs you are connected to, how far each is trusted, and the live spaces you work in together

permissions: answers other Rouhs at /link/in and its signed card at /.well-known/agent-card.json, each checked by signature and the connection's trust level in code
sends locked messages to the Rouhs its person connected to, straight through the relay or by the mailbox beside it
holds the room of each live space its person makes, and follows the rooms of spaces its person joined
accounts: the mailbox beside the rouh.page relay (mailbox.rouh.page), which holds locked messages for a Rouh that is off, up to 30 days
touches.remove: Rouh Link is part of Rouh's core and has no off switch; to take it out, remove rouh/link/, rouh/web/link.py and its routes and open paths (rouh/project/urls.py, rouh/web/gate.py), rouh/models/link.py with a migration dropping its tables, its templates and rouh/static/link/, the start in rouh/runtime.py, the orb's second colour (app/orb.js, app/orb3d.js, app/socket.js, protocol.d.ts, PROTOCOL.md), LINK.md and this manifest.
